sections.intro: Under GST rules, businesses whose aggregate annual turnover (AATO) has crossed ₹5 crore in any financial year since 2017-18 must issue e-invoices for B2B sales, exports and certain other supplies. Each invoice is reported to the Invoice Registration Portal (IRP), which returns an Invoice Reference Number (IRN) and a signed QR code. Two timing rules matter most:
rows: B2B invoices must be reported to the IRP
Invoices older than 30 days are rejected by the IRP
sections.note: ERPNext e-invoicing India setups handle both rules automatically, so invoices are reported the moment they are submitted. For official details, see the GST e-invoice portal.

sections.h2: Why Set Up ERPNext GST E-Invoicing Properly?
sections.intro: A careless setup creates problems that surface months later, often during an assessment. Wrong tax types, missing HSN codes or unreported invoices lead to mismatches between your books and the GST portal. A correct setup gives you:

items.text: One invoice that updates the IRP and e-way bill portal automatically
Fewer mismatches between GSTR-1, GSTR-2B and your books
Faster month-end, because returns data is ready from ERPNext
A clear audit trail for every invoice, cancellation and credit note

outro.text: That is why ERPNext GST e-invoicing is worth doing right the first time.

sections.h2: What We Set Up for GST in ERPNext
sections.intro: ERPNext handles Indian GST through the India Compliance app, an open-source Frappe app built for GST, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Our ERPNext GST setup covers:
rows: Each registration, state code and address
CGST, SGST, IGST, cess and exempt categories
HSN and SAC codes, tax rates and units
sections.note: ERPNext India compliance depends on clean masters. That is why ERPNext HSN setup and ERPNext GSTIN setup come before anything else.

paragraphs.text: Once configured, ERPNext e-invoice setup works in the background. When a B2B invoice is submitted, ERPNext sends it to the IRP, receives the IRN and signed QR code, and prints them on the invoice. ERPNext e-invoice portal integration also handles cancellations within the allowed window.

ERPNext e-way bill generation follows the same flow, using the same credentials and the same invoice data, so details never have to be typed twice. For goods movements that need an e-way bill, generally consignments above ₹50,000, ERPNext creates it from the invoice or delivery note. ERPNext ewaybill integration also updates vehicle details and extends validity when a delivery is delayed.
Every ERPNext GST invoice then carries the IRN, QR code and e-way bill number, ready to print or share.

ERPNext GST returns support starts with accurate invoice data. ERPNext prepares GSTR-1 data from your sales and helps reconcile purchase invoices with GSTR-2B, so you claim the input tax credit you are entitled to. ERPNext GST reports also show tax liability by rate, state and month, which makes GSTR-3B faster and safer.

TDS and TCS can also be set up in ERPNext, with deductions calculated on payments and invoices and reports ready for quarterly returns. Portal security is covered too: two-factor login on the e-invoice portal is part of our setup checklist.

sections.h2: Several States, SEZ and Export Supplies

paragraphs.text: Businesses with branches in more than one state need a separate GSTIN for each, with stock transfers between them invoiced correctly. We set up each registration as its own company or branch in ERPNext, with the right tax templates and e-way bill rules. Exports and supplies to SEZ units are configured as zero-rated, with or without payment of IGST, and shown correctly on the e-invoice. Any ERPNext GST e-invoicing setup for a growing business should plan for this from the start.

sections.intro: ERPNext GST error fixing usually starts with one of these problems:

items.text: Wrong place of supply, so IGST is charged instead of CGST and SGST
Missing or wrong HSN codes, causing e-invoice rejections
Customers marked as unregistered when they have a GSTIN
Old tax templates still in use after a rate change
Invoices not reported to the IRP within 30 days

outro.text: Each fix is tested on a copy of your system first, and we explain every change to your CA in writing, so the accounts team knows exactly what moved and why. Any ERPNext GST e-invoicing project should include a check of past invoices, so hidden errors are found before an assessment, not after.

outro.text: As an ERPNext GST consultant and ERPNext GST partner, we cover setup, fixes and ongoing ERPNext GST support. ERPNext GST compliance is not a one-time job, because rates, rules and portal requirements change, and we keep your setup current.

ERPNext GST for SME businesses is often the first real benefit of moving off Tally or spreadsheets: one invoice, reported once, with returns data ready at month-end. As ERPNext GST software, it needs no separate e-invoicing tool.

paragraphs.text: Businesses across Ernakulam use our ERPNext GST Kochi team, with workshops at our Vyttila office. We provide ERPNext GST Kerala-wide for traders, manufacturers and service firms.

paragraphs.html: Our ERPNext GST India-wide service runs remotely, including multi-state businesses with several GSTINs. For GCC VAT and e-invoicing, see ERPNext implementation in the GCC.

items.a: Yes. With the India Compliance app, ERPNext generates IRNs and signed QR codes automatically when B2B invoices are submitted. It also handles cancellations and e-way bills.
ERPNext prepares GSTR-1 data and helps reconcile purchases with GSTR-2B. Filing itself is done on the GST portal, either directly or through a GSP, with the data ERPNext produces.

items.q: Can you fix wrong GST settings?
items.a: Yes. We review templates, HSN codes, customer types and place-of-supply rules, fix the errors and check past invoices so problems are not carried forward.

items.q: Do we need e-invoicing if our turnover is below ₹5 crore?
items.a: Not yet. E-invoicing applies once AATO crosses ₹5 crore in any financial year since 2017-18. Many businesses still set it up early in ERPNext, so the change is painless when they cross the limit.

items.q: How long does GST setup in ERPNext take?
items.a: Two to four weeks for most businesses, depending on the number of GSTINs, items and customers, and how clean the existing data is.

items.q: What does GST setup in ERPNext cost?
items.a: The price depends on the number of GSTINs, items and customers, and how much cleaning the data needs. A single-GSTIN business with clean masters costs far less than a multi-state group. We send a fixed quote after a free review of your ERPNext GST e-invoicing readiness.

items.q: Does ERPNext handle e-way bills too?
items.a: Yes. ERPNext creates e-way bills from invoices or delivery notes, updates vehicle details and extends validity when needed, all without leaving the system.
